# Beautiful UI source-to-product map

Owner-selected reference: https://www.beautifului.dev/ and /harness.
Source license/revision recorded in NOTICE.md. Upstream is a demo catalog, not an agent engine.

| Primitive | JARVIS surface | Integration status / truthful constraint |
|---|---|---|
| LoadingState | Model/speech preparation, answer generation | Pixel grid/shimmer/elapsed adapted. Work state from core only. No remote Surfer video. |
| ThinkingState | Expandable voice processing diagnostics | Stage/device/timing facts only; no hidden reasoning or invented trace. No timer settles success. |
| StreamingText | Home answer rows | Real arriving text; no loop, fake sources or timed word replay. Preserve node identity during delta updates. |
| ApprovalCard | Exact browser/desktop/external review | Browser and app cards adapted. Voice binds only focused fully visible exact payload for60seconds, once. Other review domains remain pending. Existing exact payload + confirm/cancel gates preserved. Never UI-only "submitted" success. |
| ToolChips | Direct Brave action log | Real core operation events only. No fictitious files/edits/tool counts. |
| TaskRows | Speech/Laya/model/browser status | Core running/failed/ready only. No demo sequence status transitions. |
| ChatComposer | Bigfoot Home chat | Existing real message stream and chat persistence. No scripted fake replies. |
| PromptBar | Home composer | Focus/elevation adapted, actual persona/mic/Stop. Available model route only, no pretend model picker or local dictation toggle. |
| RecommendationCard | Managed-model recommendations | Plan: real hardware-fit options; no invented confidence/acceptance. Existing reviewed download. |
| ContextCards | Local notes search/read | Current captured note and search candidate cards adapted with source hash/truncation labels; not fake retrieved knowledge. |
| DiffTable | Reviewed proposed configuration/code edits | Plan: exact proposal differences; review does not apply code. No timed fake additions. |
| RecordsTable | Installed models and saved chat records | Plan: actual rows, local sort. No fabricated contact strength/AI calculation. |
| FilterTable | Model/operation status filters | Plan: actual state filters only. |
| SidebarNav | Bigfoot sidebar | Keep Bigfoot geometry. Hover glide adapted; paid icon library not imported. |
| SearchList | Saved chat/note search | Plan: actual local results, explicit empty state. |
| Flowchart | Note links / action plan | Plan: real linked note/action data. Layout interaction is not workflow execution. |
| InsightCards | Measured software stage timings | Current voice-stage metric cards adapted; no synthetic performance chart. Owner GPU/physical latency remains unverified. |
| CodeBlock | DEX reviewed code proposal | Plan: exact generated text/diff. Copy text only; no install/run callback. |
| FineTuneCard | Display settings | Plan: real supported display controls. No UI-only pretend changes. |
| SelectionActions | Selected message rewrite preparation | Plan: selected exact passage goes into draft for owner review; no canned rewritten output. |
| AgentScreen | Explicit selected-screen preview | Plan: actual current preview only. No placeholder, cursor spoofing or recording button without recording backend. |
| GlideMenu | Sidebar hover/focus | Measured existing row bounds adapted. Reduced-motion respected. |

Status is a work map, not a completion claim. Backend/regression, interaction renders and Windows acceptance must verify shipped entries before delivery.
